 06. 1.

2.

This is the 2nd bail application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Athamallik PS Case No.217 of 2022 corresponding to Special (POCSO) Case No.91 of 2022 pending in the file of learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-Cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Angul, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.450/506/376(1)/376(2)(f) of IPC r/w Sections 4(1)/6(1) of POCSO Act, on the main allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge-Cum- Special Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Heard, Mr. Kaustuva Mohanty, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. M.K. Mohanty, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the present matter and perused the record.

None appears for the informant/victim despite being duly intimated as apprised by learned Addl. PP.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis--vis the accusations sought to be brought against him and regard being had to the pre trial detention of the petitioner in custody since 18.09.2022, but trial having not yet been concluded even after more than three years of custody of the petitioner and taking into account the examination of the victim and, thereby, there being little apprehension of tampering of evidence of material witness like the victim and keeping in view the right of the accused to be presumed innocent until proven guilty at the trial, this Court without expressing any view on merits admits the petitioner to bail.

sentences.text: Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands allowed and the petitioner is allowed to go on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) only with one solvent surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin of the case on such terms and conditions as deem fit and proper by it.
6. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
7. Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
